nodes.label: entry点
nodes.description: Entry point of the application. Parses CLI flags, loads configuration, starts server.

nodes.label: config文件
nodes.description: Configuration management file. Reads system settings like home dir and PATH.

nodes.label: repository数据层
nodes.description: Data access layer. Handles SQLite storage for all installed apps data.

nodes.label: services逻辑层
nodes.description: Business logic layer. Contains functions for app listing, display, and management.

nodes.label: ui用户界面
nodes.description: GUI layer. Provides CLI entry and app listing display with selection.

nodes.label: coverage测试数据层
nodes.description: Tests collection for continuous integration/dependencies management. Maintains coverage stats.

nodes.label: tests测试节点
nodes.description: Unit tests and E2E tests for functionality verification.

nodes.label: web界面组件
nodes.description: Web-based entry point. Provides CLI-like interface with app list display.

nodes.label: handlers.go
nodes.description: API request handlers. Routes incoming requests to business logic, validates input, formats JSON responses. Handles HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Imports: service, types.
